observations.content: User reported UI pause symptom: working icon spinning and timer running with no streaming, thinking, subagent, or tool call visible, and said normally that means it has stopped.
User clarified the pause happened right after the model-override explanation answer (turn was complete), not during any tool; user stated their time was 9:09 PM GMT+7 on 2026-08-30.
User stated they had stopped the agent twice earlier (around 13:44 and 13:57/14:00) thinking it was stuck, saying they waited a long time and it seemed not to work.

Assistant ran bash to grep the latest pi session file /home/coder/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-coder-workspaces-learn--/2026-08-30T10-19-34-772Z_01a0522e-81f4-7311-8ba4-027cea97e974.jsonl (888 lines) for errors around 14:05-14:07 UTC.

Session log evidence: two 'Request aborted' entries (13:57:14 and 14:00:41, 0 tokens) were the user's stops; a normal tool error -32602 for list_models (provider required, undefined) at 14:03:33; no extension_error lines anywhere in the 888-line session file.
Assistant concluded pi and its extensions were fully exonerated by logs: the turn ended cleanly with stopReason 'stop', no extension handler hung, no extension_error present.

Assistant diagnosed the pause as the known Paseo bug 'finish notification drop' (bug #1 in the handoff list of 4 bugs): daemon recorded attentionReason finished at 14:05:54.233 while status stayed running, but the finish signal never reached the UI, which kept the spinner and timer running.

Assistant noted the user's 'Tại sao còn pause?' message arrived at 14:05:54.670, only 0.4 seconds after the daemon marked the turn finished, proving the agent was not busy and only the UI was unbriefed.
Assistant's workaround advice: if the answer is complete, press stop (safe, nothing lost since the turn already finished) or send a new message; both reset the stuck spinner.

Assistant raised a secondary hypothesis: OM fires an 'om: observer started' notification after each turn's final line, which the UI might interpret as ongoing activity and keep the spinner running; proposed a cheap experiment of watching whether the spinner sticks exactly when that notification appears, and if so making OM suppress that notification.
User stated they tested /md-log and /om:status and asked what next.
The /om:status slash command worked through the Paseo chat and output the full status block, confirming slash commands reach pi through the chat.

om status dump showed: observers in flight 0/4, active observations 256, next observer 8,193/10,000 tok, pool 14,443 tok (consolidate at 15,000), consolidator idle, last compaction wait skipped, topic files 7, journey ~1,903/1,000 tok, context 128,638/150,000 tok, session cost $0.1561 (32 runs), last error none, 2 compactions.

OM timeline showed context at 128,638/150,000 tok (high, a 3rd compaction expected soon) and journey over its 1,000 tok target so the consolidator is expected to trim on the next run; pool at 14,443 approaching its 15,000 consolidate threshold.

Assistant inspected md-log.ts and found /md-log semantics: without a filepath arg it notifies usage, requires ctx.isIdle, and the target file must already exist (it links into an existing note and never creates one, to avoid scattering files from typo'd paths).
Found markdown files in /home/coder/workspaces/learn: test-log-2.md, HANDOFF-observational-memory.md, and test-log.md, candidates for the /md-log mirror output.
